# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Super Skill is an open-source template project. It does not run any servers or services.

If you find a security issue in:
- The Cloudflare Worker blueprint (in the MCP feature document)
- Any script that handles tokens or credentials
- Any documentation that could lead users to make a dangerous configuration mistake

Please open a GitHub Issue with the label "security" or contact the maintainer
directly via the repository profile.

Do not publicly disclose vulnerabilities before giving the maintainer reasonable
time to respond (14 days).

## Scope

This policy covers the public template at github.com/Asaf-Dahan/super-skill only.
Your private Super Skill domain repos are your own responsibility.
